svg.text: Build sequence — 13 phases, ordered by dependency rather than preference
Each phase reads what the previous one wrote, so the chain is sequential except where marked. Gates are hard: nothing downstream starts until green.
PHASES 11 & 12 — parallelisable from Phase 6 onward
Infrastructure (SAM, three stacks, IAM with explicit denies, Step Functions, observability, Docker Compose local stack) and the
frontend, steering and publication pipeline. Everything else is sequential, because each phase reads what the previous one wrote.
Three orderings are not negotiable
1 · Bitemporal schema first (T1.1). knowledge_time cannot be retrofitted onto
populated stores — for several sources it is unrecoverable once ingest has run.
2 · The leakage harness gates live running. A leaked prediction cannot be re-run.
3 · The classification spot-check (T5.5) gates the wiki seed (T7.4). A
misclassification propagates into eleven years of seeded evidence.
Rebuilding the seed invalidates every live observation accrued against the old pages.
After go-live — what is known, and when
The clock below starts at go-live, not at project start. Build time is additional and is not estimated anywhere in the plan.
The price of forward-only is patience, and it is a real price.

A contaminated result available in month 1 would have to be defended for the life of the project; a clean one available later does not. But the design cannot deliver a believable *null* on its own timeline — only an interval.
Open items that block delivery — resolve before the phase they gate

g.text: Chronos-2 wheels ∩ TimesFM 2.5 wheels ∩ SAM Lambda runtimes ∩ AgentCore base image. The one irreversible toolchain choice.
FRED · GDELT attribution · whether model-derived severity is a derivative work. Question 4 is legal, not technical.
Gitignored, stored in S3, yet CI must run with no AWS account — and committing them would put scraped text in a public repo.
Each fixes a method, not a value — fitted against data that does not exist yet. Four are free against the seed join.
Nova pricing and availability · AgentCore + SAM coverage · Chronos context length · TimesFM licence · deterministic seeding.
REQ-406's shared regime block buys cross-instrument coherence and is what correlates the predictor's errors. Unresolved by design.

svg.text: Definition of done — per deliverable

g.text: Runs unattended for 60 trading days inside its time budget,
halts rather than degrades, and never publishes past a market open.
Every canary is proven catchable against a deliberately leaky
variant, and the package installs and runs outside this repo.
Any prediction is traceable to its prompt snapshot and the exact
page versions that produced it; both skill series always render.
A third party can re-derive every reported figure from the
published artefacts alone, without access to this account.
That last one is the real test — it is what makes a null believable.

svg.text: Success is a trustworthy answer, not a favourable one

The learning thesis is directly observable: the agent's edge over the comparator, plotted over elapsed calendar time, with its interval. If the wiki compounds, that line trends up. If it is flat, the wiki is not

contributing — and that is a finding. A negative result is valid and publishable, and rarely demonstrated rigorously in this field. The design exists to make that claim defensible rather than to make it come out well.
